title: Surveys | Kaderblick Docs

hero.heading: Surveys
hero.lead: Surveys collect answers from selected teams, clubs or—with suitable permission—the whole platform. One survey can combine different question types and have a due date.

body:
Survey overview

  • Coloured edge and status: distinguish open, answered and expired surveys.
  • Questions and answers: counters show question and received-response counts.
  • Due date: appears as a date or remaining time. An expired unanswered survey is marked accordingly.
  • Link icon: copies the direct participation link.
  • Answer now, Answer late or Answer again: opens the form according to the current state.
  • Results: appears only if you may view them.
  • Pencil and bin: appear only for people allowed to edit or delete this survey.

Create a survey

1. General

  • Title: required survey heading.
  • Description: explains purpose or context.
  • Due date: optional final date.
  • Assign teams: targets one or more available teams.
  • Assign clubs: targets one or more available clubs.
  • Entire platform: a separate target. Team, club and platform selections are mutually exclusive.

Select Next. If title or valid target is missing, the wizard identifies it.

2. Questions

Enter the question and choose:

  • Single choice: exactly one option.
  • Multiple choice: several options.
  • Free text: unrestricted text.
  • Scale 1 to 5: five-step rating.
  • Scale 1 to 10: ten-step rating.

For choice questions, select existing options or create your own, then add the question. Added questions can be edited or deleted. At least one complete question is required.

3. Summary

Check title, description, due date, target and every question. Back corrects an earlier step; Finish saves the survey.

Answer a survey

  1. 1
    Open the survey
    Select the offered answer button on its card or open the direct link.
  2. 2
    Answer questions
    Choose one or more options, write free text or move the scale slider.
  3. 3
    Review answers
    Review every question. For scales, the slider shows the selected value.
  4. 4
    Submit
    Select Submit at the end. Kaderblick then confirms receipt.

An answered survey can be reopened with Answer again. After expiry, the interface may offer Answer late.

Results

The result view shows completion status and answers for each question. Choice and scale questions are summarised; free texts appear individually. Access depends on the survey and your role or relationship with its target group.
